coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.tagline: Vietnam's Finest Coffee for Global Roasters
coffee.description: Vietnam is the world's second-largest coffee exporter, producing over 1.8 million tonnes annually. We export premium Robusta (Grade 1, Screen 18+) from Dak Lak and specialty Arabica from Da Lat's high-altitude farms. Supply chain traceability to farm cooperative level, ICO-certified, and available with HACCP, ISO 22000, and Rainforest Alliance documentation.
coffee.longDescription:
Vietnam's coffee industry is a powerhouse of global supply. The Central Highlands — encompassing Dak Lak, Gia Lai, Kon Tum, and Lam Dong provinces — produce the vast majority of the country's output, benefiting from volcanic red basalt soils, consistent rainfall, and elevations of 500–1,600 metres above sea level.

Robusta (Coffea canephora) dominates production at approximately 95% of output, prized for its high caffeine content (~2.7%), intense body, and lower price point. It is the backbone of the world's instant coffee industry and widely used in Italian espresso blends. Our Grade 1 Robusta meets SCAA commercial standards with cupping scores of 78–82, with premium micro-lots available at 82+.

Arabica production has grown significantly in Lam Dong province (Da Lat), where cooler temperatures enable quality profiles rivalling Central American origins. Specialty-grade Arabica with cupping scores of 82–87 is available for import by specialty roasters.

All exports comply with Vietnamese Government Decree 107/2018 on coffee export standards. Pre-shipment inspection by SGS, Intertek, or Bureau Veritas can be arranged. ICO export certificates, phytosanitary certificates, and fumigation records are provided with every shipment.

cashew-nuts.name: Cashew Nuts
cashew-nuts.tagline: Vietnam — The World's #1 Cashew Kernel Exporter
cashew-nuts.description: Vietnam processes over 650,000 MT of cashew kernels per year, making it the global market leader. We export W180, W240, W320, W450, and broken grades (SP, LP, SW, LW, BB) with aflatoxin testing, HACCP, and FDA-registered facilities. Packed in vacuum nitrogen-flushed tins or cartons as per buyer specification.
cashew-nuts.longDescription:
Vietnam's position as the world's leading cashew kernel exporter is built on decades of investment in processing infrastructure, strict quality management, and strategic sourcing from West Africa (Ivory Coast, Ghana, Nigeria) and domestic farms in Binh Phuoc and Ba Ria-Vung Tau provinces.

Cashew processing in Vietnam involves multiple stages: steam sterilization, shelling, peeling, grading, and packaging. Our facilities operate with automated optical sorting equipment to achieve colour and size uniformity. W-grade kernels (whole white) are the premium tier, with W180 (large) commanding the highest prices and W320 being the global standard for retail markets.

Aflatoxin testing is conducted on every lot by accredited third-party laboratories. Total aflatoxin levels are maintained below 4 ppb (EU standard) and 20 ppb (US FDA standard). Our facilities are HACCP certified, FDA-registered for US market access, and hold BRC Grade A for European retail supply.

Key export markets include the USA, Netherlands, Germany, UAE, China, and Australia. We can arrange private label packaging in retail-ready resealable pouches, tins, or bulk cartons.

rice.name: Rice
rice.tagline: Mekong Delta Rice — Feeding the World with Quality
rice.description: Vietnam is a top-3 global rice exporter. We supply Jasmine/ST25 (premium fragrant rice), Long Grain White (5% and 25% broken), Glutinous/Sticky, and Brown Rice. Mekong Delta origin, ISO 22000 certified mills, competitive FOB Ho Chi Minh City pricing.
rice.longDescription:
The Mekong Delta — Vietnam's rice bowl — produces three crops annually, benefiting from the Mekong River's nutrient-rich waters and year-round growing conditions. Vietnam exports approximately 6–7 million tonnes of rice annually to over 150 countries, with the Philippines, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, and African nations being the largest buyers.

Our rice supply chain spans registered export mills in An Giang, Can Tho, Dong Thap, and Tien Giang provinces. All mills hold ISO 22000 food safety certification and are registered with Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD) for export.

Jasmine/ST25 rice represents Vietnam's premium export grade — ST25 was awarded World's Best Rice in 2019 and 2023, featuring a distinctive pandan aroma and fluffy texture. Long Grain White Rice (5% and 25% broken) forms the bulk of Vietnam's commercial exports and is competitively priced for government tenders and wholesale buyers. Glutinous rice serves specialty food markets in East and Southeast Asia, while Brown Rice caters to health-conscious consumer markets in Europe and North America.

We offer consolidation services, allowing buyers to combine multiple rice varieties in a single FCL shipment.

frozen-seafood.name: Frozen Seafood
frozen-seafood.tagline: Vietnam's HACCP-Certified Frozen Seafood for Global Markets
frozen-seafood.description: Vietnam is the world's 3rd largest seafood exporter. We export IQF and block-frozen Vannamei shrimp, Pangasius (Basa) fillets, squid rings, and other seafood products. EU-listed, FDA-registered, HACCP and ASC certified facilities. Cold chain maintained from processing to port.
frozen-seafood.longDescription:
Vietnam's seafood export industry generates over USD 8 billion annually, with shrimp and Pangasius (Basa catfish) as the flagship commodities. Processing facilities in the Mekong Delta and coastal provinces operate under strict food safety protocols mandated by VASEP (Vietnam Association of Seafood Exporters and Producers) and international certification bodies.

Frozen Vannamei (white leg) shrimp is processed at facilities in Ca Mau, Bac Lieu, Soc Trang, and Khanh Hoa. Size grades range from 6/8 to 41/50 per pound, with HLSO (Headless Shell-On), PUD (Peeled Un-Deveined), PD (Peeled Deveined), and CPTO (Cooked Peeled Tail-On) forms available. Sodium bisulphite-free (antibiotic-free) production is available for premium markets.

Pangasius (Basa) fillets are processed in the An Giang and Dong Thap provinces, the heart of Vietnam's catfish farming industry. Skin-off, boneless white fillets are available in IQF or block frozen, with trim levels A, B, and C catering to different market requirements.

All seafood processing facilities in our network hold DL (approved establishment) numbers from the National Agro-Forestry-Fisheries Quality Assurance Department (NAFIQAD), ensuring EU and US market access. Cold chain logistics are managed from processing plant to container stuffing.

spices.name: Spices
spices.tagline: Vietnamese Spices — The World's Premium Source
spices.description: Vietnam is the world's largest black pepper exporter and a major supplier of star anise and cinnamon. We export Black Pepper (500 GL+), Star Anise (whole, broken), and Vietnamese Cinnamon/Cassia (Quế Yên Bái). ASTA-grade, HACCP certified, available in bulk and retail packs.
spices.longDescription:
Vietnam's spice export portfolio is anchored by three globally significant commodities: black pepper, star anise, and cinnamon. Together, these make Vietnam one of the world's most important origins for professional spice traders.

Black Pepper from Ba Ria-Vung Tau, Dak Lak, and Dak Nong provinces accounts for roughly 35–40% of global trade. We export 500 GL+ and 550 GL+ black pepper (ASTA clean quality), white pepper, and green pepper. Piperine content ranges from 5–9% depending on origin and harvest timing.

Vietnamese Star Anise (hồi) from Lang Son and Cao Bang provinces is recognized by global perfumers and food manufacturers as among the finest available. Trans-anethole content of 85%+ and low camphor ensure a bright, clean anise profile suitable for pharmaceutical, food, and fragrance applications.

Vietnamese Cinnamon (Cassia — Cinnamomum loureiroi) from Yen Bai province commands the highest price among global cinnamon varieties due to its exceptional cinnamaldehyde content (3–5%, versus 0.5–1% for Indonesian Cassia). Known locally as Quế Yên Bái, it is sought after by high-end spice importers in the EU, USA, and Middle East.

green-tea.name: Green Tea
green-tea.tagline: Premium Vietnamese Green Tea — From Thai Nguyen to the World
green-tea.description: Vietnam is Southeast Asia's largest tea producer. We export Thái Nguyên loose-leaf green tea (the Gold Standard of Vietnamese tea) and Jasmine Green Tea. Available in bulk (25 kg bags), foodservice catering packs, and retail OEM packaging. HACCP certified, pesticide-tested, ISO 22000.
green-tea.longDescription:
Vietnam's tea cultivation heritage spans over a century, with Thái Nguyên province in the Northern midlands being universally acknowledged as the country's premium tea-growing region. The combination of red ferralitic soils, cooler highland temperatures (15–25°C), and careful hand-plucking traditions creates a tea with exceptional colour, aroma, and taste characteristics.

Thái Nguyên green tea (Trà Thái Nguyên) is processed using the pan-firing (炒) method, which gives it a distinctive fresh, vegetal aroma and bright jade liquor. Unlike Chinese green teas, Vietnamese green tea is typically not steamed, resulting in a slightly different flavor profile that is highly valued by tea connoisseurs in Taiwan, Japan, and the Middle East.

Jasmine green tea (trà hoa nhài) is produced by layering fresh jasmine blossoms with tea leaves, allowing natural scenting without artificial fragrances. Each lot goes through 5–9 scenting cycles to achieve optimal jasmine integration.

All tea exports comply with EU and US maximum residue limits (MRLs) for pesticides. Third-party pesticide testing reports from SGS or Eurofins accompany every shipment. Moisture content is maintained below 7% for optimal shelf stability during sea freight.

pineapple.name: Pineapple
pineapple.tagline: Vietnam's Sweet, Certified Pineapple — Fresh and Processed
pineapple.description: Vietnamese pineapple — both fresh Queen/MD2 and canned in syrup. Tien Giang and Kien Giang origin. GLOBALG.A.P. certified farms, HACCP-certified canneries. Consistent supply 12 months/year. Premium sweet flavour profile ideal for European and Middle Eastern retail markets.
pineapple.longDescription:
Vietnam produces approximately 700,000 tonnes of pineapple annually, with Tien Giang, Kien Giang, and Ninh Binh as the main production provinces. Two main varieties dominate exports: the Queen pineapple (small, intensely sweet, aromatic) suited for fresh markets, and MD2 (also called Gold or Extra Sweet), the global retail standard with uniform golden flesh and 12–16 Brix sweetness.

Fresh pineapple export season runs year-round, with peak volumes from March to June and October to December. GLOBALG.A.P. certification from partner farms ensures food safety and traceability standards required by European and Middle Eastern supermarket chains.

Canned pineapple production follows Vietnam's strong tradition in tropical fruit processing. Pineapple canned in light syrup or heavy syrup is available in standard retail sizes (565g, 820g) and foodservice tins (A10). HACCP and ISO 22000 certified canneries operate year-round with consistent throughput.

Vietnamese canned pineapple is competitively priced versus Thai and Philippine origins while maintaining excellent quality — brix levels of 14–18 in the packing syrup, firm fruit pieces, and low defect rates. We supply on FOB Ho Chi Minh City or CNF terms.

textile-apparel.name: Textile & Apparel OEM
textile-apparel.tagline: Vietnam OEM Garment Manufacturing — Your Brand, Our Expertise
textile-apparel.description: Vietnam is the world's 3rd largest garment exporter. We facilitate full-package OEM manufacturing: design-to-delivery for t-shirts, polos, outerwear, workwear, sportswear, and more. Partner factories hold WRAP, BSCI, and OEKO-TEX certifications. Minimum 300 pcs per style.
textile-apparel.longDescription:
Vietnam's garment manufacturing industry employs over 3 million workers and generates USD 36+ billion in annual exports. The industry benefits from competitive labour costs, a skilled workforce, modern factory infrastructure, and Free Trade Agreements with the EU (EVFTA), UK (UKVFTA), and 15 ASEAN+ nations under RCEP.

Our partner factory network is concentrated in Ho Chi Minh City, Binh Duong, Dong Nai, and Hanoi industrial zones. Factories range in size from boutique sample studios to large-scale facilities producing 50,000+ pieces per day. All factories have been audited against WRAP (Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production) and/or BSCI (Business Social Compliance Initiative) standards.

We operate as a full-service sourcing and manufacturing coordinator. Buyers provide tech packs, approved samples, or detailed design briefs; we coordinate fabric sourcing, sample production, approval, bulk production, quality control, and freight forwarding. Sample lead time is 2–3 weeks; bulk production is typically 45–90 days from approved sample.

Product categories include basic and fashion t-shirts, polo shirts, dress shirts, sportswear, outerwear, denim, workwear, uniforms, bags, and accessories. Sustainable fabric options (GOTS organic cotton, GRS recycled polyester, Tencel) are available through our certified fabric suppliers.
textile-apparel.oemDescription: We provide full OEM garment manufacturing services including tech pack review, fabric sourcing, sample production, bulk manufacturing, final QC inspection, and export documentation. Private label, custom woven labels, hangtags, and retail-ready packaging are available. Our team of merchandisers manages your production in English and Vietnamese, ensuring smooth communication from brief to shipment.

precision-components.name: Precision Components
precision-components.tagline: CNC Machined Parts & Industrial Components from Vietnam
precision-components.description: Vietnam's precision engineering industry serves global OEMs in automotive, electronics, and industrial sectors. We export CNC-machined precision components in aluminium, steel, brass, and stainless steel. ISO 9001 certified factories, tolerances to ±0.01mm, CMM inspection reports provided.
precision-components.longDescription:
Vietnam's precision manufacturing ecosystem has grown rapidly over the past decade, driven by FDI from Samsung, Foxconn, LG, Toyota, and Bosch, which have established world-class supply chains that local component makers now serve. This ecosystem has created a deep pool of precision machining capability across the Hanoi-Haiphong corridor and Ho Chi Minh City industrial zones.

Our partner factories specialise in CNC turning, CNC milling, EDM, grinding, and multi-axis machining. Materials processed include aluminium alloys (6061, 7075, 2024), carbon steel, stainless steel (304, 316), brass, copper, and engineering plastics. Surface treatments available include anodizing, electroplating, powder coating, and black oxide.

Quality management follows ISO 9001:2015 standards with full CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) inspection capabilities. First Article Inspection (FAI) reports, material certifications (MTRs), and PPAP documentation are available upon request. Cpk studies and SPC can be provided for high-volume production runs.

Typical lead times are 3–4 weeks for prototypes/low volumes and 6–8 weeks for production runs. DFM (Design for Manufacturability) feedback is provided for complex geometries before quoting.
precision-components.oemDescription: We provide full OEM manufacturing services for precision components including DFM review, prototype production, PPAP documentation, SPC reporting, and serial production. Your engineering drawings (PDF, DXF, STEP, IGES) are treated with strict NDA protection. Custom packaging, kitting, and consignment inventory arrangements are available.

wooden-furniture.name: Wooden Furniture
wooden-furniture.tagline: Handcrafted Vietnamese Furniture — FSC Wood, Global Standards
wooden-furniture.description: Vietnam is the world's 5th largest furniture exporter (USD 14 billion annually). We export acacia outdoor furniture, solid teak indoor furniture, and rattan/bamboo pieces. FSC-certified timber, CARB Phase 2 compliant, available for private label retail. ISO 9001 certified factories.
wooden-furniture.longDescription:
Vietnam's furniture industry has evolved from low-cost production to design-forward manufacturing catering to premium markets in the USA, EU, Japan, and Australia. The industry's strength lies in skilled craftsmanship, abundant FSC-certified acacia and teak timber from legal plantations, and factories that can handle both large-scale retail volumes and bespoke hospitality orders.

Acacia wood, grown in plantations across Binh Duong, Binh Dinh, and Quang Ngai provinces, has become the material of choice for outdoor furniture due to its natural hardness (Janka 1,750+ lbf), weather resistance, and attractive grain pattern. All acacia sourced from FSC-certified plantation forests, ensuring legal and sustainable origin.

Solid teak indoor furniture from Vietnam uses plantation teak from Lam Dong and the Central Highlands. Plantation teak, while younger than traditional Burmese teak, achieves excellent colour and grain uniformity and is preferred by responsible buyers due to its legal and certified supply chain.

All furniture factories in our network comply with CARB Phase 2 formaldehyde emission standards for composite wood components, ensuring US market access. CE marking documentation is available for the European market.
wooden-furniture.oemDescription: We facilitate OEM furniture manufacturing with your brand's specifications, including custom dimensions, stains, hardware, and retail packaging. CAD drawings, 3D renders, and physical samples can be arranged. Private label options include custom logo branding on hardware, swing tags, and carton artwork.

eco-packaging.name: Eco Packaging
eco-packaging.description: Kraft paper bags, corrugated boxes, biodegradable packaging, and eco-friendly packaging solutions from Vietnam. FSC-certified paper sources, recycled content options available. Suitable for food, cosmetics, apparel, and general retail. Custom printing, embossing, and die-cutting. MOQ 5,000 units.
eco-packaging.longDescription:
Vietnam's packaging manufacturing industry has invested heavily in sustainable materials in response to global retailer demand for environmentally responsible supply chains. Our eco-packaging range covers kraft paper bags (flat bottom, gusset, stand-up pouches), corrugated shipping boxes, moulded pulp inserts, biodegradable mailer bags, and custom gift box packaging.

All paper and board raw materials are sourced from FSC-certified paper mills, with recycled content options available for buyers seeking post-consumer waste (PCW) packaging credentials. Water-based inks are used for all printing, eliminating VOC emissions and ensuring food-contact safety where applicable.

Customization options include offset and flexo printing (up to 8 colours), UV spot varnish, foil stamping, embossing/debossing, and custom die-cuts. Structural design services are available for new packaging development, including CAD templates and physical mockups before tooling commitment.

We supply packaging manufacturers, brands, retailers, and e-commerce fulfilment operations. Product categories served include food and beverage, cosmetics and personal care, apparel and footwear, electronics accessories, and luxury goods.
eco-packaging.oemDescription: Custom OEM packaging designed and manufactured to your brand specifications. We handle structural design, artwork file preparation, pre-press, sample production, and bulk manufacturing. White-label options (no Vietnamese origin marking) available for brand-sensitive buyers.

raw-materials.name: Raw Materials
raw-materials.tagline: Industrial Raw Materials from Vietnam — Cement, Minerals & More
raw-materials.description: Portland Cement (OPC 42.5 / 52.5 N/R), limestone, silica sand, and industrial minerals from Vietnam. Vietnam produces 100+ million MT of cement annually with significant export capacity to Southeast Asia, Africa, and South Asia. ASTM C150 / EN 197-1 certified. Bulk vessel and bagged shipments.
raw-materials.longDescription:
Vietnam is one of Southeast Asia's largest cement producers, with installed capacity exceeding 100 million metric tonnes per year. Major cement-producing provinces include Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, Ha Nam, and Quang Ninh, where abundant limestone deposits support large integrated cement plants.

Portland Cement OPC 42.5 and 52.5 (both Normal and Rapid setting) are manufactured to TCVN 2682:2020 / ASTM C150 / EN 197-1 standards. All cement carries quality certification from Vietnam's Institute for Building Materials (VIBM) and can be supplied with third-party test reports from SGS, Bureau Veritas, or TÜV Rheinland.

Cement is exported in 50 kg PP woven bags (on pallets or loose), big bags (1 MT), or bulk (in geared vessels or with pneumatic conveying equipment). Export markets include the Philippines, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Mozambique, Madagascar, and Pacific Island nations.

Beyond cement, Vietnam also exports limestone (for agriculture and industrial use), silica sand (for glass manufacturing, construction, and water filtration), and kaolin clay. Mineral quality specifications and export volumes are available upon request.

home-personal-care.name: Home & Personal Care
home-personal-care.tagline: OEM Personal Care Products — Private Label from Vietnam
home-personal-care.description: Liquid hand soap, body wash, shampoo, conditioner, and personal care products for private label and OEM. GMP-certified factories, dermatologically tested formulations, custom fragrance, viscosity, and packaging options. Vietnam's personal care export industry is growing 15%+ annually.
home-personal-care.longDescription:
Vietnam's home and personal care OEM manufacturing sector has developed robust capabilities serving global brands, regional distributors, and private label retailers. GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) certified facilities in Ho Chi Minh City, Binh Duong, and Hanoi produce liquid soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand sanitiser, and cleaning products.

Formulation development is conducted by in-house cosmetic chemists who can adapt existing proven formulations or develop custom formulations to buyer requirements. All formulations are tested for pH stability, viscosity consistency, microbiological safety (TPC, yeast/mould, pathogen testing), and dermatological compatibility (patch testing available).

Fragrance options span fresh/clean, floral, herbal, citrus, and premium fragrance families. Preservative systems comply with EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC 1223/2009) and US FDA requirements for both leave-on and rinse-off products.

Packaging options include HDPE, PET, and PP bottles in standard and custom shapes, as well as refill pouches and bulk containers. Label printing (flexo, offset, metallic, holographic) and custom bottle moulding are available from our packaging partners.

All products can be registered for import into target markets — we provide complete product documentation including Safety Data Sheets, Certificate of Analysis, INCI ingredient lists, and regulatory compliance statements.
home-personal-care.oemDescription: Full OEM manufacturing including formulation development, safety testing, packaging sourcing, labelling, and regulatory documentation. Private label under your brand. All formulas are treated as confidential and customers retain full ownership of custom formulations.

hygiene-disposable.name: Hygiene & Disposable
hygiene-disposable.tagline: Wet Wipes, Tissues & Disposable Products — Vietnam OEM Supplier
hygiene-disposable.description: Non-woven wet wipes (baby, facial, antibacterial, flushable), dry tissue, and disposable hygiene products from Vietnam. OEM and private label available. Custom formulations (fragrance-free, alcohol-free, medicated). CE marked where applicable. MOQ 50,000 packs.
hygiene-disposable.longDescription:
Vietnam's non-woven and hygiene disposable manufacturing sector has expanded dramatically, supplying both domestic demand and growing export markets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. Modern non-woven converting lines produce spunlaced (hydroentangled) and thermal bonded materials used in wet wipes, dry wipes, facial cloths, and industrial wipes.

Our wet wipe manufacturing partners operate ISO-certified cleanroom environments for the higher-grade products (baby wipes, feminine care wipes). Water quality for wipe solutions is purified using reverse osmosis systems to pharmaceutical-grade standards. Preservative systems are formulated to comply with EU 1223/2009 (cosmetic wipes) and EU 2017/745 (medical-grade wipes where applicable).

Customization options include: substrate selection (spunlace viscose/polyester blend, bamboo fiber, organic cotton), lotion formulation (fragrance-free, alcohol-free, vitamin E, aloe vera, medicated), folding format (single fold, cross fold, Z-fold, canister roll), and packaging format (flow pack, canister, resealable pouch, sachet).

Product categories in our range include baby wipes, feminine hygiene wipes, makeup remover wipes, antibacterial surface wipes, household cleaning wipes, and flushable wipes. All products can carry your private label branding.
hygiene-disposable.oemDescription: Full OEM service including substrate selection, lotion formulation, fragrance development, packaging design, and regulatory compliance documentation. Custom pack counts, packaging materials, and private label printing available. NDA protection for all formulations.

baby-products.name: Baby Products
baby-products.tagline: Safe, Certified Baby Products — OEM Manufacturing from Vietnam
baby-products.description: Baby wipes (ultra-soft, fragrance-free), baby diapers/nappies, baby toiletries, and baby care accessories. OEM manufacturing in Vietnam. EN 71 / ASTM F963 safety standards, SGS-tested materials, dermatologically tested. OEKO-TEX Standard 100 available. Custom private label.
baby-products.longDescription:
Baby product manufacturing requires the highest standards of material safety, formulation quality, and quality control — standards that Vietnam's leading OEM factories have invested in achieving to penetrate premium markets. Our partner factories for baby products have undergone comprehensive material safety testing under OEKO-TEX Standard 100 (for textiles and non-wovens) and EN 71 / ASTM F963 (for baby care products).

Baby wipes are manufactured with ultra-soft, high-weight spunlace substrates (70 GSM+) using purified water, aloe vera, and fragrance-free formulations. Alternative formulations with vitamin E, chamomile extract, or probiotics are available for premium positioning. All wipe solutions are dermatologically tested and hypoallergenic.

Baby diapers are produced with soft backsheet materials, SAP (superabsorbent polymer) cores with high absorption capacity, and wetness indicator strips. Size range from NB (Newborn) to XXL (15 kg+). Pants-style pull-ups are also available.

Our approach to baby product OEM puts safety documentation first — we proactively provide complete material safety documentation packages including substance restriction compliance statements (REACH, CPSC), migration testing results, skin patch test reports, and ingredient declarations.
baby-products.oemDescription: OEM baby product manufacturing with full safety documentation. We manage formulation safety testing, packaging compliance, and customs documentation. Custom branding including embossed logo on diapers, custom wipe packaging, and personalized fragrance options.

cleaning-tools.name: Cleaning Tools
cleaning-tools.tagline: Microfiber Mops, Brushes & Cleaning Accessories from Vietnam
cleaning-tools.description: Microfiber mop systems, brooms, dustpans, scrubbing brushes, and cleaning accessories from Vietnam. OEM and wholesale. EN 14565 microfiber standards, custom handle colours and branding, sustainable material options. Suitable for retail, janitorial, and hospitality supply.
cleaning-tools.longDescription:
Vietnam's cleaning tools manufacturing sector combines low production costs with modern production lines serving global janitorial supply companies, retail chains, and hospitality suppliers. Product lines span microfiber floor care (mops, pads, dusters), brooms and brushes, squeegees, and complete cleaning trolley systems.

Microfiber products are manufactured from polyester/polyamide split-fiber technology, producing fibers finer than 1 denier. This creates the electrostatic dust-trapping and bacteria-removing properties valued by healthcare, hospitality, and commercial cleaning operators. Microfiber pile heights, GSM weights, and weave patterns are fully customizable.

Brooms are available in natural fiber (sorghum, coconut coir), synthetic fiber (PET, polypropylene), and mixed bristle configurations. Handle options span wood, fiberglass, aluminum, and telescopic/extendable designs. All handles and metalwork comply with EN 13623 and REACH substance restriction requirements.

Our factories hold ISO 9001:2015 certification and regularly supply to major European DIY chains, supermarket private labels, and US janitorial distribution companies. Minimum order quantities start at 500 units per SKU for branded programs.
cleaning-tools.oemDescription: Full OEM cleaning tools manufacturing including custom logo silk-screening on handles, custom packaging design, and multi-SKU retail sets. We supply complete branded cleaning tool ranges for supermarket private labels, including planogram layout support.

plastic-household.name: Plastic Household Items
plastic-household.tagline: Durable Plastic Household Products from Vietnam
plastic-household.description: Plastic storage containers, kitchenware, laundry baskets, hangers, and household plastic items from Vietnam. BPA-free PP and HDPE materials, food-grade certified where applicable. Custom colours, custom logo, retail packaging available. OEM wholesale from 1,000 units.
plastic-household.longDescription:
Vietnam's plastics manufacturing industry is a significant contributor to the country's export economy, producing a wide range of household and consumer products for global markets. Modern injection moulding facilities in Ho Chi Minh City, Binh Duong, and Hanoi Industrial Zones use food-grade PP, PE, and HDPE materials with BPA-free certification.

Our product range spans food storage containers (stackable boxes, vacuum containers, refrigerator organizers), kitchenware (colanders, cutting boards, mixing bowls, utensil holders), laundry and bathroom accessories (baskets, hangers, soap dishes, toothbrush holders), and organizational products (storage bins, shoe racks, cable organizers).

All food-contact products comply with EU Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 and are tested for specific migration limits of plasticizers and heavy metals. US-bound products comply with FDA 21 CFR regulations for food contact materials.

Customization includes custom colours (Pantone matching available), custom mould development (from CAD files or physical samples), custom branding (silk screen, heat transfer, or label), and custom retail packaging (print-ready carton artwork). Tooling costs are amortized over production volumes through agreed arrangements.
plastic-household.oemDescription: OEM plastic household product manufacturing including mould development, colour matching, surface treatment, and custom retail packaging. We handle product registration documentation for EU/US markets and provide CE, BPA-free, and food-contact compliance certificates.

canned-preserved-food.name: Canned & Preserved Food
canned-preserved-food.tagline: Vietnam Canned Seafood, Vegetables & Fruits — Export Grade
canned-preserved-food.description: Canned tuna, canned pineapple, canned corn, pickled vegetables, and preserved food products from Vietnam. HACCP and ISO 22000 certified factories. EU-approved establishments. Custom label printing, private label OEM. Standard and foodservice sizes available.
canned-preserved-food.longDescription:
Vietnam's canned and preserved food export sector benefits from abundant raw material supply — tropical fruits, freshwater and marine fish, and agricultural produce — combined with modern HACCP-certified processing infrastructure.

Canned tuna is one of Vietnam's major seafood export products, primarily processing skipjack tuna (Katsuwonus pelamis) from Pacific Ocean fishing grounds. Canned in water, brine, sunflower oil, olive oil, or tomato sauce. Chunk, flake, and solid pack styles available in 170g, 185g, and 400g standard retail sizes.

Canned vegetables include sweet corn (cream style and whole kernel), green peas, kidney beans, chickpeas, and bamboo shoots. Canned tropical fruits include pineapple (chunks, slices, crushed), lychee, longan, jackfruit, and mixed tropical fruit.

All canned food production facilities in our network hold HACCP and ISO 22000 certification. EU-listed establishments (EU approved list) can be provided on request. HACCP plans, allergen declarations, nutritional data, and product specifications are provided with new product samples.
canned-preserved-food.oemDescription: OEM canned food production under your private label. We manage label printing, nutritional panel compliance for target markets (EU, US, Middle East, Southeast Asia), and import registration documentation.

packaged-food-snacks.name: Packaged Food & Snacks
packaged-food-snacks.tagline: Instant Noodles, Snacks & Packaged Foods from Vietnam
packaged-food-snacks.description: Instant noodles (OEM), biscuits, crackers, wafers, candy, chocolate products, and packaged snack foods from Vietnam. HACCP certified, Halal available, custom formulation and packaging for private label. Vietnam is a major OEM hub for branded food companies.
packaged-food-snacks.longDescription:
Vietnam's packaged food and snack manufacturing sector has matured into a sophisticated OEM hub for regional and global food brands. The combination of food-grade raw material availability (wheat flour, sugar, palm oil, flavourings), skilled food technologists, and competitive production costs makes Vietnam highly attractive for food brand owners seeking Asia-Pacific manufacturing bases.

food-staples.longDescription:
Vietnam's food staples export sector encompasses a broad range of essential commodities — salt, sugar, flour, pasta, and grains — that form the backbone of household and institutional food supply chains worldwide.

Refined iodized salt is produced from Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, and Binh Thuan coastal provinces, where evaporation ponds deliver high-purity raw salt for refining. Food-grade iodized salt meets WHO iodine fortification standards (20–40 ppm KIO3) and is tested for heavy metals and microbiological safety.

Sugar production in Vietnam's Mekong Delta and Central Highlands regions produces both granulated white sugar (ICUMSA 45 for premium, 150 for commercial) and refined specialty sugars (caster, icing, raw/natural brown). Sugar is available in retail packs (500g, 1 kg), 25 kg bags, and bulk 50 kg bags.

Wheat flour production uses imported wheat (predominantly from Australia, Canada, and Ukraine) milled in Vietnam to consistent protein specifications. All-purpose flour (10–11% protein), bread flour (12–13% protein), and cake flour (8–9% protein) are produced to food industry specifications with consistent water absorption values.

Pasta (dry) is produced using durum wheat semolina to Italian-standard quality specifications, available in standard shapes (spaghetti, penne, fusilli, farfalle) for retail and foodservice.

edible-oils-fats.longDescription:

This combination makes Vietnam a competitive sourcing hub for edible oil buyers seeking Asian production with competitive pricing.

Refined coconut oil (RBD — Refined, Bleached, Deodorized) is produced from Vietnamese coconut farming concentrated in Ben Tre and Tra Vinh provinces. Vietnam's coconut oil has a higher natural lauric acid content (48–52%) than many other origins, making it valuable for both food and cosmetic applications. Expeller-pressed virgin coconut oil is also available from small-batch processors.

Vegetable shortening and margarine production uses hardened palm oil, soybean oil, and palm kernel stearin blends, produced to specifications required by industrial bakers, confectionery manufacturers, and foodservice operators. Plastic, liquid, and spray formats are available.

All edible oil and fat products are produced in HACCP and ISO 22000 certified facilities. Halal certification (from HALAL Vietnam, JAKIM, or MUI) is available for Muslim market supply. Non-GMO verified options available for European and US markets.
